# hg reset

**What this page tells you:** every `hg reset` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Tear the local environment down.

## Synopsis

```text
hg reset [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--nuclear` | — | — | Also delete the cluster and every artifact. |
| `--allow-repo-scripts` | — | — | Permit repo-provided teardown scripts to execute. |
